sh: winged reptile, horns, long spiked tail
f: Breathes fire. Hoards loot. Judges you.

sh: wingless dragon, low body, ember back spikes
f: All the dragon, none of the flight lessons.

sh: big head, stubby wings, round belly
f: Sneezes sparks. Very proud of it.

sh: crystal horns, frosted wings, icicle tail
f: Its breath gives the whole arena brain freeze.

sh: jagged wings, crackling mane, forked tail
f: Every roar comes with free thunder.

sh: smoky wings, violet eyes, wispy tail
f: Blends into the night. Bumps into the moon.

sh: boulder plates, mossy back, no wings
f: Took up digging when flying got boring.

sh: long finned serpent body, crest of fins
f: Surfs its own tidal waves.

sh: leafy wings, vine beard, bark scales
f: Its breath smells like a very angry garden.

sh: gleaming gold scales, wide wings, crown horns
f: Shinier than its entire hoard.

sh: faceted crystal body, prism wings
f: Reflects your spells and your life choices.

sh: ribcage body, tattered wing bones, green glow
f: Died once. Didn't take.

sh: long whiskered serpent, small legs, flowing mane
f: Brings rain, luck, and a great parade.

sh: winged serpent, feathered wings, no legs
f: A snake that refused to stay on the ground.

sh: two legs, bat wings, barbed stinger tail
f: Two legs, two wings, one very pointy tail.

sh: wingless serpent with two clawed forelegs
f: Two arms, zero patience.

sh: giant shell with spikes, dragon head
f: Slow, armored, and breathes steam. Rude.

sh: butterfly wings, tiny dragon, sparkle trail
f: Breathes glitter. Takes no questions.

sh: two necks, one fire head, one ice head
f: Two heads, constant arguments.

sh: massive horned head, ragged ancient wings
f: Older than mountains. Twice as grumpy.

sh: dragonfly with tiny lance rider
f: Tiny lance. Enormous courage.

sh: flaming feathers, long tail plumes
f: Dies dramatically. Comes back fabulously.

sh: crystal feathers, snowflake tail
f: Reborn from a snowball. Very chill about it.

sh: massive eagle, lightning feather tips
f: Flaps once: thunder. Flaps twice: weather report.

sh: colossal eagle, huge talons
f: Snacks on elephants. Probably exaggerating.

sh: peacock tail, dog face, golden plumes
f: Wise enough to know you're about to miss.

sh: eagle head, human body, golden wings
f: Snake catcher, wind racer, golden show-off.

sh: feathered wings, taloned legs, wild hair
f: Steals your lunch with a screech.

sh: sea maiden on a rock, flowing hair
f: Sings a song you can't get out of your head.

sh: bronze feathers shot like darts
f: Sheds razor feathers. Terrible pillow.

sh: snow white bird, glowing gaze
f: Looks at you. Your cold is gone.

sh: crimson pheasant, flame tail ribbons
f: Guardian of the south and of spicy weather.

sh: heron with sunbeam crest
f: Ancient sun bird. Very early riser.

sh: eagle front, horse hindquarters
f: Bow first. It insists.

sh: lion body, eagle head and wings
f: Half lion, half eagle, fully in charge.

sh: white horse, feathered wings
f: A horse that skipped the road entirely.

sh: white horse, spiral horn, rainbow mane
f: Pointy, sparkly, emotionally unavailable.

sh: horned winged horse, starry mane
f: Both the horn and the wings. Showing off.

sh: black stallion with burning hooves and mane
f: The horse you see right before you wake up.

sh: dripping horse, seaweed mane
f: Offers you a ride. Do not take the ride.

sh: horse front, fish tail, fin mane
f: The ocean's preferred taxi.

sh: grey stallion with eight legs
f: Eight legs. Zero traffic.

sh: scaled deer, single horn, flame wisps
f: Walks on grass without bending it. Show-off.

sh: many snake necks rising from one body
f: Cut off one head and it brings friends.

sh: giant three-headed hound, spiked collar
f: Three heads. Three times the belly rubs needed.

sh: lion head, goat head, snake tail
f: Assembled from leftover animals. Furious about it.

sh: bull head, giant arms, labyrinth axe
f: Lost in a maze. Taking it out on you.

sh: human torso on horse body, bow in hand
f: Half archer, half horse, all hooves.

sh: snake hair, stony stare
f: Don't look. No, really. Don't.

sh: towering one-eyed giant, huge club
f: Great at aiming. One eye shut is cheating.

sh: lion body, headdress, folded wings
f: Answer the riddle or lose the turn.

sh: lion body, bat wings, spiked scorpion tail
f: Lion, bat, scorpion. Three bad ideas in one.

sh: giant serpent, crown crest, glowing eyes
f: One glance and you're a lawn ornament.

sh: rooster head, dragon wings, snake tail
f: A chicken with a petrifying attitude.

sh: serpent lower half, monstrous crown
f: Mother of monsters. Proud of every one.

sh: storm giant with serpent legs and wings
f: Father of monsters. Storm in a bad mood.

sh: six snarling heads on long necks
f: Six heads. Zero personal space.

sh: ocean whirlpool with a gaping maw
f: A whirlpool that's always hungry.

sh: massive lion, gleaming impervious hide
f: Fur so tough swords just bounce.

sh: huge tusked boar, bristled back
f: Ruined every picnic in ancient Greece.

sh: giant bronze statue warrior
f: Ancient robot. Takes walks around islands.

sh: goat legs, small horns, pan pipes
f: Plays panpipes. Won't stop.

sh: woman of bark and leaves
f: Lives in a tree. Rent is cheap.

sh: glowing water spirit maiden
f: Lives in a pond. Very territorial about it.

sh: winged avenger, snake hair, torch
f: Holds grudges professionally.

sh: towering ancient giant, stone muscles
f: Older than gods. Bigger than buildings.

sh: enormous bronze statue that walks
f: A statue with places to be.

sh: snake lower half, jeweled headdress
f: Half snake, half smirk.

sh: fluffy beaked cub, tiny wings
f: All fluff, no flight skills yet.

sh: giant covered in watchful eyes
f: Has a hundred eyes. Still loses its keys.

sh: endless sea serpent biting own tail
f: Wrapped around the world. Still hungry.

sh: colossal grey wolf, broken chain collar
f: Chewed through a magic chain. Still teething.

sh: towering blue giant, icicle beard
f: Brings winter wherever he stomps.

sh: magma skin giant, flaming sword
f: Walks around setting things on fire. On purpose.

sh: giant in clouds, lightning crown
f: Throws thunder like snowballs.

sh: hunched giant, boulder in hand
f: Not the brightest. Very much the biggest.

sh: winged helm, spear, flying steed
f: Picks the bravest warriors. You're on the list.

sh: armored undead viking, glowing blue eyes
f: An undead viking guarding treasure. Forever.

sh: fiddler sitting in a waterfall
f: Plays violin in a waterfall. Never tunes.

sh: black serpent dragon gnawing roots
f: Chews on the roots of the world.

sh: squirrel with message scrolls
f: Spreads gossip up and down the world tree.

sh: forest woman with a cow tail
f: Hides a tail. Hides it badly.

sh: tiny bearded house gnome, red hat
f: Wants porridge. Will prank you without it.

sh: colossal squid with ship-crushing tentacles
f: Release it. Please. It's been waiting.

sh: endless armored sea serpent
f: The ocean's largest regret.

sh: looping serpent humps above waves
f: Sailors swear it was this long.

sh: gigantic armored beast, tree-sized legs
f: When it walks, the map vibrates.

sh: bird so large its wings block the sun
f: Its wings cause eclipses.

sh: bandage-wrapped shuffler, glowing eyes
f: Wrapped like a gift nobody wanted.

sh: golden death mask, striped headdress, bandages
f: Woke up from a 3000-year nap. Still tired.

sh: carpet of shiny green beetles
f: A carpet that bites.

sh: smoke tail rising from a lamp, gold cuffs
f: Grants three wishes. Reads the fine print.

sh: smoky fire spirit, horns, burning tail
f: A genie with anger management issues.

sh: towering water genie, foam beard
f: A genie that grants wishes only if they're wet.

sh: hunched pale creature, long claws
f: Lurks in graveyards eating snacks it shouldn't.

sh: jackal head, golden collar, long staff
f: Weighs your heart. Yours is a bit heavy.

sh: swirling sand figure with ember eyes
f: Gets in your eyes. Gets in everything.

sh: colossal ringed worm, round toothy maw
f: The desert's favorite surprise.

sh: winged bull with bearded human head
f: A gatekeeper with excellent beard care.

sh: chick the size of a car
f: Big baby. Bigger appetite.

sh: maned lion beast, single horn
f: Scared of firecrackers and the color red.

sh: winged lion with antler horn
f: Eats gold. Never shares.

sh: stone lion statue, curly mane, ball under paw
f: A stone guard dog who never sleeps.

sh: stiff arms outstretched, robe, paper talisman
f: Hops after you. Can't bend its knees.

sh: white fox with nine fluffy glowing tails
f: Nine tails, nine tricks, zero apologies.

sh: scaled lion with a bell, single horn
f: Eats fire. Guards palaces.

sh: white ox with many eyes and horns
f: Knows every monster by name.

sh: long blue sky dragon, wind ribbons
f: Guardian of the east. Always on time.

sh: white tiger with metal-streaked stripes
f: Guardian of the west. Loves a good pounce.

sh: black tortoise with a snake coiled around
f: Two creatures, one shell, constant debates.

sh: orange fox with glowing tails, foxfire wisps
f: One more tail every hundred years.

sh: turtle-shelled imp with a water dish on head
f: Bow to it. Its head water spills.

sh: long red nose, black wings, fan in hand
f: Master swordsman. Mostly a nose.

sh: red horned brute, spiked iron club
f: Big club, bigger temper, nice tiger shorts.

sh: blue horned brute, frost club
f: The chill one of the oni family.

sh: pale ghost in white kimono, snowy breath
f: Very pretty. Very cold. Bring a jacket.

sh: round bellied raccoon dog with straw hat
f: Shapeshifter. Mostly into being a teapot.

sh: cat with forked tail, ghost flames
f: Knocked things off tables for 100 years.

sh: giant spider with silk kimono
f: Spins webs. Plays the lute. Multitasker.

sh: tapir-like beast with trunk and tusks
f: Eats nightmares. Leaves crumbs.

sh: giant black head rising from the sea
f: Asks for a bucket. Do not give it a bucket.

sh: towering skeleton fifteen times human size
f: Rattles so loud it wakes the neighbors.

sh: whirlwind weasel with sickle claws
f: Three weasels, one tornado, many papercuts.

sh: woman with stretching noodle neck
f: Her neck goes out for snacks at night.

sh: blank egg face, schoolkid uniform
f: Turns around. No face. Classic prank.

sh: tiny white tree spirit, rattling head
f: Rattles its head. That means hello.

sh: old umbrella with one eye and a leg
f: After 100 years your umbrella gets opinions.

sh: paper umbrella, one eye, long tongue, one leg
f: An umbrella that hops and licks.

sh: wolf of blue lightning, crackling tail
f: Naps in belly buttons during storms.

sh: oni drummer in a ring of thunder drums
f: Drums so hard the sky crackles.

sh: oni with a giant wind bag over shoulders
f: Opens the bag. Everybody's hat leaves.

sh: cobra hooded serpent, jeweled crest
f: A serpent king with excellent taste in jewels.

sh: crocodile jaws, elephant trunk, fish tail
f: Part croc, part elephant, part confused.

sh: tiger-headed illusionist in robes
f: Master of illusions and backwards palms.

sh: lion body, elephant trunk, horse legs
f: Guarding temples since forever.

sh: two-headed golden eagle
f: Two heads, both looking at you.

sh: white elephant with many tusks and trunks
f: Carries clouds. Sprays rain.

sh: lion-like guardian, golden mane, mirror scales
f: Protector of villages and dance stages.

sh: tiny green imp child
f: Steals coins. Leaves candy wrappers.

sh: goat-legged piper, curling horns
f: One tune and everyone panics.

sh: deer with golden antlers, bronze hooves
f: Fast enough to outrun arrows.

sh: serpent coiled around golden apple tree
f: Guards golden apples. Never shares.

sh: whale body, dog head, fish tail
f: Eats coastlines. Saves room for dessert.

sh: fiery hair, one bronze leg
f: One bronze leg. Great at kicks.

sh: fluffy white foal, tiny wings
f: Wings too small. Tries anyway.

sh: wailing ghost woman, streaming silver hair
f: Screams so high only dogs can hear the chorus.

sh: tiny bearded man in green coat with pot of gold
f: Never tells you where the gold is.

sh: seal with a woman's face, silky coat
f: A seal on weekdays, a person on weekends.

sh: black shaggy horse with gold eyes
f: Gives wild rides. No refunds.

sh: headless rider holding glowing head aloft
f: Has no head. Still gives you a look.

sh: wiry goblin, iron boots, crimson cap
f: Wears iron boots. Still faster than you.

sh: tiny shaggy house helper
f: Cleans your house. Don't say thank you.

sh: lumpy shapeshifter in the cupboard
f: Lives in your closet. Rearranges your socks.

sh: bigger goblin, studded leather, wide grin
f: A goblin who went to the gym.

sh: soggy little horse with reed mane
f: Cute until it drags you into a pond.

sh: shaggy green wolfhound, braided tail
f: A big green dog with three warning barks.

sh: huge black cat with white chest patch
f: A cat who knows you skipped your homework.

sh: sea horse spirit with dripping mane
f: The kelpie's scarier cousin.

sh: huge shaggy black dog, red glowing eyes
f: Saucer eyes and a deeply spooky bark.

sh: skinless horse-rider fused as one
f: The worst horse in Scottish history.

sh: wolf-headed fisherman in a wool sweater
f: A wolf man who leaves you fish. Wholesome.

sh: transparent mastiff with blazing eyes
f: The dog of darkness walks itself.

sh: beaver-crocodile lake monster
f: A lake monster with dam problems.

sh: long neck, humped back above still water
f: Blurry in every single photo.

sh: tiny winged sprite with glowing dust trail
f: Small. Glittery. Deeply chaotic.

sh: glowing mote with insect wings
f: Mostly sparkle, partly attitude.

sh: tall fae with crown of flowers and moth wings
f: Rules the fairies. Bans iron and Mondays.

sh: tiny fairy with a giant tooth bag
f: Pays cash for teeth. No questions.

sh: pointy red hat, white beard, blue coat
f: Stands perfectly still. Until you blink.

sh: stout bearded miner with axe and helmet
f: Short, strong, and twice as stubborn.

sh: pointed ears, longbow, leaf cloak
f: Never misses. Never lets you forget it.

sh: pale hair, violet skin, twin blades
f: Lives underground. Hates sunlight and mornings.

sh: hooded archer in mossy cloak
f: Talks to trees. Trees reply.

sh: tall elegant elf, silver armor, staff
f: Thinks very highly of high elves.

sh: tiny elf in green with bell hat
f: Makes 300 toys a day. Needs a nap.

sh: barefoot small adventurer, curly hair
f: Seven meals a day. One adventure a year.

sh: blank-eyed fae kid, shifting outline
f: Looks just like you. Better hair.

sh: crowned ghost with spectral veil
f: Her scream knocks hats off from a mile away.

sh: old witch flying in a mortar with a pestle
f: Lives in a chicken-legged house. Rent is weird.

sh: log cabin on giant chicken legs
f: A house that runs away from visitors.

sh: gaunt skeleton king with hidden soul egg
f: Hid his heart in an egg. Very organized.

sh: three-headed green dragon
f: Three heads and one shared bad mood.

sh: river maiden with long wet hair
f: Sits by the river. Laughs at your fishing.

sh: tall bark-skinned giant with moss beard
f: Moves the trail markers just to watch.

sh: small hairy grandpa spirit near the stove
f: Guards the house. Needs milk and cookies.

sh: frog-faced old man with green beard
f: Grumpy pond grandpa. Wants you out.

sh: tiny spindly spirit with a spinning wheel
f: Tangles yarn. Tangles life.

sh: glowing peacock bird with ember tail
f: One feather lights a whole room.

sh: pale cloaked undead with red eyes
f: An older, crankier vampire.

sh: cloud maiden with swan wings
f: Dances on clouds. Bad at sharing them.

sh: bird with a woman's face, sweet song
f: One song and you forget your worries.

sh: prophetic bird with human face
f: Tells the future. It's mostly spoilers.

sh: green-haired water sprite
f: A water fairy with a splash of mischief.

sh: small dog-faced miner with lantern
f: Steals ore. Sets traps. Wears a hard hat.

sh: cat-headed lizard worm
f: A cat-faced lizard that hisses at hikers.

sh: shaggy horned figure with chains and basket
f: Santa's grumpy partner. Very hairy.

sh: rabbit with antlers and tiny wings
f: A bunny that went to antler school.

sh: turtle shell, lion head, six bear legs
f: A turtle that bench-pressed a castle.

sh: stone winged statue, horns, crouched
f: Stone by day, party by night.

sh: squat stone face on a ledge
f: Makes faces at you. Literally made of faces.

sh: serpent-tailed lady with dragon wings
f: Princess on top, snake on bottom, wings too.

sh: tiny prankster in pointed cap
f: Braids horse manes at night. Why? Nobody knows.
